decisions.why: Examples are named ENT surgical sets: Nasal Polypectomy Set, Major Nasal Set, Oto-Rhino-Laryngological Surgery Set, Middle Ear Set - all directly ENT surgical instrumentation.
Examples are named ophthalmic surgery sets: Retinal Surgery Set, Lacrimal (DCR) Surgery Set, Squint Surgery Set, Strabismus Surgery Set - surgical packs for specific ophthalmic procedures.
Examples name ear/auricular instruments and classic otologic instrument eponyms: House-Dieter malleus forceps, McGee wire-bending forceps, and two 'Micropinza Auricular' (ear micro-forceps) items.
